The loan structure and classifications are broken down into the following categories:

list.snippet: Shishu: Loans up to $\mathbf{\$50,000}$ (for businesses in the initial starting stages).
Kishore: Loans from $\mathbf{\$50,001}$ up to $\mathbf{\$5}$ lakh (for businesses that have established operations).
Tarun: Loans above $\mathbf{\$5}$ lakh up to $\mathbf{\$10}$ lakh (for expanding established micro-enterprises).
Tarun Plus: Loans above $\mathbf{\$10}$ lakh up to $\mathbf{\$20}$ lakh (specifically for entrepreneurs who have previously availed and successfully repaid their loans under the Tarun category).

response.reconstructed_markdown:
The maximum loan amount under the Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana \(PMMY\) is $\mathbf{\$20}$ \(via the newly introduced Tarun Plus category\). [0]

The loan structure and classifications are broken down into the following categories:

- Shishu: Loans up to $\mathbf{\$50,000}$ \(for businesses in the initial starting stages\).
- Kishore: Loans from $\mathbf{\$50,001}$ up to $\mathbf{\$5}$ lakh \(for businesses that have established operations\).
- Tarun: Loans above $\mathbf{\$5}$ lakh up to $\mathbf{\$10}$ lakh \(for expanding established micro\-enterprises\).
- Tarun Plus: Loans above $\mathbf{\$10}$ lakh up to $\mathbf{\$20}$ lakh \(specifically for entrepreneurs who have previously availed and successfully repaid their loans under the Tarun category\). [0] [1] [2]

You can check out more details or apply through official financial portals like the State Bank of India PMMY Portal or the [JanSamarth Portal](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVQHrOzAVnXE64MPSgUp-EkBJ4ClxMuG_9d9P45JObhlK_HcfAn29ZzJ8TuNJIT4lzGGyoyB5DKNAdOq1vNrMdK2vXouPSQdMCZmo6KjyKJkyaUPh2X4). [3] [4]
